name: Yanase Sara
source:
A first-rate alchemist whose interests begin and end with her own research.
She is always calm, composed, and mature beyond her years, yet she also has a playful, mischievous side.
Once she takes a liking to someone, she will happily tease them just for the fun of it.
Thanks to Ruri's unreasonable demands, she ends up getting roped into transmuting all manner of quirky goods.
